claim: Three release-28 apply scripts are written against the release-19 scripts. Every constant that the release changes is taken from the build record (RESIDENT_BUILD.json) or the release-19 output, and each changed line is justified in scripts[].changes. Every guard that refuses before anything moves is kept, and the pre-read gains one refusal (the r28 root must be absent). All three pass bash -n, are ASCII, and carry no secret-like string. The staged sums file equals the tarball member and the release-19 method reproduces the staged r19 file byte for byte. Nothing was run on any host, nothing was uploaded, and no AWS, SSH or SSM call was made.
